details: A dependency-confusion stub in the @cloudplatform-single-spa scope that impersonates an internal platform package, using version 99.99.99 to win semver resolution. The ~7.8KB package runs a postinstall lifecycle hook (scripts/postinstall.js) that contacts the command-and-control domain oob[.]moika[.]tech on install. The package has since been removed from the registry.
